title: Moonlit Ocean & Lunar Rays
subtitle: Volumetric Moonbeams, Silver Water Wake & Bioluminescent Waves
description: Nocturnal atmospheric optical simulation of a silver full moon casting volumetric moonbeams through cirrus cloud breaks onto an undulating ocean. Computes lunar atmospheric scattering, a specular silver glitter wake, background star scintillation, and glowing cyan bioluminescent phytoplankton.
mathNotation: I_{\text{moon}}(\theta) = I_0 \cdot e^{-\sigma r} \cdot P_{\text{Mie}}(\theta) \cdot \mathcal{O}(\theta, t), \quad W(x, y) = e^{-\frac{(x - x_{\text{moon}})^2}{2\sigma_{\text{wake}}^2}} \cdot \left[\nabla \eta \cdot \mathbf{L}\right]^m
formulaCompact: I_lunar(r, θ) = I_0 exp(-σr) P(θ) · [Σ A_k cos(k θ + ωt)],  wake = exp(-Δx²/2w²) · (N · L)^m
